provider.description: Built-in provider id or a registered provider id.

model.description: Model id for the active provider.

baseUrl.description: Override the provider API base URL.

lsp.description: Language servers to start (user config only).

autonomy.description: Autonomy preset when permissionMode is unset (maps to permission mode).

trustedWorkspaceHooks.description: Absolute workspace paths allowed to load workspace hooks.json.

notify.description: Turn-end bell prefs (`bell`, `minMs`). User config only.

statusLine.description: User status-line script: command + optional args (JSON on stdin).
